basic_profile.bio: A recent transplant to Denver, I'm exploring the Mile High City's vibrant culture. I have a background in education and currently work as an online ESL teacher with VIPKid, which allows me to work flexible hours from home. I'm single and love spending my free time discovering local hiking trails and experimenting with new recipes. My interests often lead me to subreddits about local sports and animal care, as I recently adopted a rescue dog. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings after signing off from work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Education and have been teaching English as a Second Language for over three years. I am constantly learning about new teaching methodologies through online courses and peer discussions. My interest in animals is more personal, stemming from my upbringing in a rural area where I interacted with various pets and wildlife.
